title: For 'fields' param in add_bitmask_, check item masks
description:
Only run 'fields' checks now on arrays that are the 'fields' args
to add_bitmask_ calls.  Also, check for overlapping or repeated
masks within a 'fields' array.

Fix the following issues:

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-lat.c data_b_slot_control_flags_fields has overlapping mask - { hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_enable_input_flow_control, hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_disable_input_flow_control, hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_enable_output_flow_control, hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_disable_output_flow_control, hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_break_detected, hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_set_port_char, hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_report_port_char, NULL } combined currently 0x3f hf_lat_data_b_slot_control_flags_report_port_char adds 0x20

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-nfs.c fsid_fields has overlapping mask - { hf_nfs_fh_fsid_major32, hf_nfs_fh_fsid_minor32, NULL } combined currently 0xfffc hf_nfs_fh_fsid_minor32 adds 0x3ffff

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-rtls.c rtls_nack_flags has overlapping mask - { hf_rtls_nack_flags_internal_error, hf_rtls_nack_flags_station_not_found, hf_rtls_nack_flags_reserved, NULL } combined currently 0x3 hf_rtls_nack_flags_reserved adds 0xd

                     warnings_found += 1
